goal: Arrange the five nesting dolls upright in a straight row, ordered by size from the smallest at the smallest world x to the largest at the largest world x, and return the arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
success: Define the order of the dolls by their model index mod 5, as the code does: 0 = the LARGEST doll, 4 = the SMALLEST (measured on the dolls of the frozen layout: their bounding boxes shrink as index mod 5 grows; the comments in RoboDojo's config, index 5 smallest and index 9 largest, have it the wrong way round). The code lists the dolls sorted by (index mod 5) DESCENDING: L0 = the smallest doll, L1, L2, L3, L4 = the largest.
Row straightness: the maximum minus the minimum world Y of the five dolls' root positions is <= 0.035 m.

Order along X: for each consecutive pair (L_k, L_{k+1}), k=0..3: x(L_{k+1}) - x(L_k) > 0.03 m (strict), i.e. the SMALLEST doll has the smallest world x, and x increases by more than 3 cm with each larger doll; the largest doll has the largest world x. (This matches the instruction's 'left to right, from smallest to largest' with left = smaller world x.)
Upright: each of doll0..doll4 has its local +Z axis within 15 deg (default threshold, strict) of world +Z (standing, not lying).

Both target arms are back at origin: all target arms (left_arm and right_arm; the support arm is not counted) have their end-effector pose within 0.15 m on EACH axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| all <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angle) of the pose they had at the start of the episode (recorded after the scene settled).
All conditions hold simultaneously after one action.
evaluation: Single stage; all 1 + 4 + 5 + 1 = 11 conditions must hold at the same time after one action. The reward manager is evaluated only once per action (after the sim sub-steps of that action are finished), never between sub-steps. In each evaluation the FIRST pending stage of the check list is tested (every condition in it, all at that same moment; a condition that is a nested list is an OR); when it passes it is removed permanently (never re-verified later) and the next stage becomes pending; at most one stage is removed per action. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. No early failure.
objects: doll0..doll4: five matryoshka nesting dolls (Rigid, 'matryoshka_dolls', models 0-4, 5-9 or 10-14 (three texture groups; 5 distinct dolls of one group)), one of each size; labels are random wrt size, table-frame x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.25,-0.05], random yaw up to +-45 deg, margin 0.02; the config's prohibited rectangles reserve the target-row positions (x = -0.24, -0.12, 0.0, 0.12, 0.24 around y approx -0.12) so dolls do not start on their goal spots
needs_memory_or_language: none (the order is by size; sizes can be inferred visually, the instruction is generic).
end_requirements: Both arms within 0.15 m per axis and 20 deg of their start pose in the same action as the dolls are correctly sorted, upright, and in a row.
notes: The required X gap between consecutive dolls is only > 0.03 m between root positions (roots, not edges), while the row's Y spread must be <= 3.5 cm for all five, so the dolls need to be tightly aligned in y but only loosely spaced in x. The yml comments place the targets at table-frame x = -0.24 (index mod 5 = 4), -0.12, 0.0, 0.12, 0.24 (index mod 5 = 0) and call index mod 5 = 4 the largest; the dolls' measured sizes say the opposite (index mod 5 = 4 is the smallest), so the smallest doll goes at the smallest x. Any positions satisfying the stated rules succeed. Dolls must stay upright (within 15 deg) - a doll left lying fails.
